Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Data Analyst position at your mid‑sized logistics company. With four years of hands‑on experience using pandas and scikit‑learn, I built a customer‑churn model that reduced false‑positive alerts by 18 % over six months, and I led a team of three to deliver the work. I have used SQL occasionally in my analyses, though I am still building my dashboard experience. I am eager to bring my analytical background to your organization.
